mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 8.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering immediate equity sell-offs within 5 trading days as corporate hiring freezes reduce earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 1% monthly indicate broad demand contraction, causing 60-day negative S&P 500 returns as recession fears intensify.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% in 1 month fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in at least 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profit visibility, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as growth expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, immediately boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Annual consumer price index growth exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering 60-day negative S&P 500 returns as the Federal Reserve is expected to implement rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points indicate labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession risks escalate.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise >0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise >0.2pp in 1 month fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), higher interest rates reduce equity valuations and slow economic growth, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.
